AB_operator_restrictions: Native continuity, Nu_half and section conservation are NOT_LIKE_FOR_LIKE; no hard AB threshold. Ra1e6 unaccepted B diagnostic only.

causal_candidates.assessment: A and B implement different equations (frozen A model; docs/routeB_design.md). That difference exists; a causal contribution to Gate D contrast is untested.
A uses physical pressure, B kinematic pressure; different scaling can affect matrix/residual behavior, but no controlled matched-formulation test identifies causality.
A thermodynamic Boussinesq rho and mass flux versus B constant-density continuity with buoyancy rhok; neither physical superiority nor convergence causation follows.
A sensible internal energy e versus B temperature T equation; residual fields and work terms differ. Causal effect untested.
No condition numbers or matched linear systems measured; scaling/formulation may contribute.
Foundation13 fluid vs Foundation6 buoyantBoussinesqSimpleFoam are distinct implementations. Accuracy or causal convergence advantage is not established.
Both employ steady SIMPLE paths; effects of detailed correction sequence are not isolated by this matrix.
e/T and physical/kinematic pressure are different solved quantities; same threshold does not prove identical residual meaning. Matched normalization study absent.
Section and native continuity operators explicitly differ; they are NOT_LIKE_FOR_LIKE. Their causal contribution to iterative classifications remains untested.
A passes at 3000/3000/9000; B remains unaccepted at 30000 each, with recorded residual/heat-trend failures. Different histories are observed, not an explanation of their origin.
